changes.change_plan: Keep owner-local query pending evidence. If query failure is reachable, return explicit status through existing caller error path; if admission can race, compose query and reservation under existing authoritative locking rather than add duplicate readiness state.

changes.missing_evidence: Need actual query-failure contract and service dispatch concurrency proof across query-to-CheckVDM; current fixtures prove ordinary pending/not-pending and rundown states, not those boundaries.
